stories.title: Russia's Victory Day celebrations are dampened by ongoing war with Ukraine
stories.summary: World War 2 Victory Day celebrations in Moscow will be muted this year because of fears of drone attacks, as the public tires of the Ukraine war.

stories.title: What's behind Trump's pardons of people convicted of public corruption?
stories.summary: President Trump has granted pardons to officials who were convicted of public corruption while also dismantling a federal office responsible for investigating and prosecuting corruption allegations.

stories.title: Organizers of a canceled human rights conference in Zambia say China intervened
stories.summary: Zambia was due to host Rights Con, the world's biggest digital rights gathering, this week -- but abruptly canceled the event. Organizers blame Chinese pressure for the decision.

stories.title: Tennessee Democrat speaks about his erased district
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with Democratic Congressman Steve Cohen of Tennessee, who represents that state's 9th Congressional district, which could be eliminated based on a new redistricting map.

stories.title: After their shepherd dies, 'The Sheep Detectives' set out to solve the mystery
stories.summary: In The Sheep Detectives, a shepherd (Hugh Jackman) is murdered, and his flock -- yes, the woolly, four-footed critters -- resolves to solve the crime.

stories.title: Lack of U.S. response to hantavirus outbreak worries public health experts
stories.summary: Public health experts are raising concerns about why the U.S. government hasn't had a more public response to the hantavirus outbreak that started on a cruise ship.
